scope: Real cross-application URI grants from an ordinary app's private sandbox. Shell commands installed/launched the helper and controlled the cold-start lifecycle; the file URI and grant were sent by the helper's normal startAbility call, not privileged aa URI injection. Existing material import was deliberately idempotent, preserving private learner history. Fresh package import through SystemPicker is evidenced separately.
